proof_contract: Automatic PBP / witnessed DSR / witness-free DSR routed by pinned VeriPB+CakePB, no-option dsr-trim→Trestle for witnessed SR, or validated DSR→DRAT→drat-trim→CakeLPR for witness-free DSR against the original CNF.
cleanup_contract: O_TMPFILE on /tmp for input, DSR, LSR, model and checker scratch; no directory entries ever. Kernel releases storage at last close, including SIGKILL/OOM. Fail closed if unsupported. Only bounded JSON metadata and scheduler logs persist; core dumps disabled. Each ordinary four-CPU, 32768-MiB cpu-q allocation runs the solver/checker in an exact four-CPU, 32768-MiB Slurm task step. Co-located tasks share node /tmp: each holds one locked slot of a fixed private node ledger (bounded metadata only), waits at most 300 seconds for 100000000000 available bytes, inherits a 60000000000-byte per-file limit, and permits at most six simultaneously live anonymous files. A one-second floor monitor stops the participant with the most accounted anonymous bytes when available space falls below 40000000000 bytes, and every participant below 20000000000 bytes. Such a stop, an admission timeout, or ENOSPC is retryable incomplete infrastructure evidence.
caveat: If the entire job dies, its result may be missing; never interpret missing as timeout or checked. A declared scratch admission, contention, ENOSPC, or file/handle limit is incomplete infrastructure evidence, never a proof rejection, timeout, or closure.
